With its unique blend of exploration, combat, and character progression, Object 73: Survival Clicker has something to offer both casual and hardcore gamers.

As you navigate through the game, you'll encounter a variety of challenges, from hostile enemies to resource management. The game's addictive nature is a result of its cleverly designed rewards system and incremental upgrades. Object 73: Survival Clicker is available on multiple platforms, including mobile and PC. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Object 73: Survival Clicker is a clicker game where you control a clone known as Object 73. The game's objective is simple: survive, gather resources, and upgrade equipment to progress through the game. The gameplay mechanics are divided into three main categories: exploration, combat, and character progression.

Combat is the primary way to progress through the game. As you explore the Jericho Complex, you'll encounter various enemies, from mutants to rogue synthetics and combat drones. To defeat these enemies, you'll need to click on them to attack. Defeated enemies drop materials that can be used to craft new items, upgrade equipment, and unlock new areas. The combat system is simple yet addictive, making it easy to get caught up in the game's fast-paced action.

Character progression is another key aspect of the game. As you collect resources and defeat enemies, you'll earn experience points that can be used to upgrade your clone's attributes. Upgrades include increased health, damage output, and resource gathering speed. With each upgrade, you'll become more effective at surviving in the Jericho Complex. Character progression adds a layer of strategy to the game, as you need to balance resource gathering with combat and exploration.

The game also features an RPG-like system, where you can craft new items, skills, and equipment. These upgrades can be used to enhance your combat abilities, increase resource gathering speed, or provide other benefits. With a wide range of upgrades to choose from, you'll need to decide which ones to prioritize and how to allocate your resources.
